briefing: Duration. 45 minutes on a synchronised countdown. The paper auto-submits at T‑00:00.
Display lock. The terminal must remain in fullscreen. Exiting opens a 10-second re-dock window.
Focus discipline. Switching tabs, windows or applications is logged instantly and costs one strike.
Strike ledger. Three strikes trigger automatic lockout and forced submission of the paper.
Optical presence. Your face must remain in frame. Absence, second profiles and device glare are flagged.
Input sandbox. Right-click, copy, cut, paste, selection, print and developer shortcuts are disabled.
Marking. Three schemes run in the same paper: +2/0 standard, +2/−1 high-stakes, +4/−2 multiple-correct.
Navigation. Free movement across all four modules; responses may be cleared or flagged for review.
Audit. Every anomaly is timestamped and printed into your post-test dossier for the invigilation panel.
Integrity. No external material, second screen, headset or assistance of any kind is permitted.
